newsitem.title: JAPAN: INSIGHT -JGBs may edge higher, watching Nikkei.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -JGBs may edge higher, watching Nikkei.

text.p: FUTURE RANGE/DAY SPPRT RSTNC RSI-9 MA-5 MA-25
OUTLOOK OF BOJ OPERATION AT 0020 GMT: injection of 400 bln

*JGBs are likely to edge higher during Monday Tokyo trade, although moves depend on activity of Nikkei stock index, which fell by over 500 on Friday. *Further falls to provoke buying, while quick recovery to 20,000 level will cap topside. *Buying of cash bonds by investors also will lend support. *Friday falls in U.S. bonds and concern about high prices to cap gains.
